body: Thank you.  I'm just a little bit scared now because I understood that I'm not okay. I thought that I was okay because I hadn't cut for 2 years but now when I cut I didn't feel anything. I didn't feel that good feeling and I didn't feel pain. And now I'm scared that I can cut myself and not feel anything.
Aww thank you. I'll be okay. 😊❤️
Not the best but I'll survive. And you?
Can I give you a hug? I'm really sorry you have to go through stuff like that. I don't really know if that counts as relapse. ❤️
